overloadPatches.semanticRole: Return the numeric form of expression, using separator (if passed) as the decimal separator when expression is a Text; Boolean/Integer expressions convert directly (True/False to 1/0, or pass through).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the optional trailing parameter is a Text decimal separator (or omitted entirely); mutually exclusive with the base syntax.

jointConstraints.rule: separator is only meaningful (and only legal to pass) when expression is Text -- confirmed via real 4D compiler: Num(True;"x") and Num(1;"x") are both rejected ("Incompatible type"). When expression is Boolean or Integer, call Num(expression) alone, with no second parameter at all.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Return the numeric form of a Text expression parsed in the given base/radix (2-36), e.g. for hexadecimal or binary string conversion.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the second parameter is a required Integer radix between 2 and 36; mutually exclusive with the separator syntax.

jointConstraints.rule: This syntax (with a base argument) is only legal when expression is Text -- confirmed via real 4D compiler: Num(True;1) and Num(1;1) are both rejected ("Incompatible type"). When expression is Boolean or Integer, there is no base-syntax equivalent; call Num(expression) alone (the separator-syntax overload with no second parameter).
